corpus_correction.overstrong_sentence: The normalization of g_tw is fixed once Equation (FS_norm) is chosen.
corpus_correction.replacement: Equation (FS_norm) fixes the fiber overlap I_F and hence the relation g_eff^(-2)=I_F/g_tw^2; it does not fix the independent positive action amplitude g_tw without an additional source theorem.

paper_equation: g_eff^(-2)=I_F/g_tw^2 with I_F=2 pi for the displayed constant SU2 harmonic

theorem.name: TwistorFiberNormalizationAmplitudeCountermodel
theorem.statement: Holding the Fubini-Study measure and normalized harmonic fixed while rescaling g_tw by lambda>0 preserves all displayed fiber data and rescales g_eff^-2 by lambda^-2. Fiber normalization alone therefore cannot select g_tw.
